short_summary: Erasmia: 0 of 21 combos reached 3. All 71 crawler candidates across every combo (attorneys, automotive, beauty, building, catering, retail, hardware, printing, recruitment, restaurants, software, solar, spas, etc.) were national chains, dictionary/definition pages, directory search pages or unrelated content with no Erasmia-specific match -- none cleared the 2-source+phone+address bar, so nothing was published.

Olievenhoutbosch: 0 of 17 combos reached 3. All 46 crawler candidates were generic/national results (chains, dictionary pages, unrelated junk) with no Olievenhoutbosch-specific business found; none cleared the verification bar.
Heuweloord: 0 of 13 combos reached 3. All 47 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the 2-source+phone+address bar.
Ninapark: 0 of 13 combos reached 3. All 43 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar.
Centurion Central: 0 of 11 combos reached 3. All 37 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar.
Faerie Glen: 0 of 7 combos reached 3. All 20 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar.

Sunnyside: 0 of 5 combos reached 3. All 18 crawler candidates were generic/national results or unrelated content (no suburb-specific match); none cleared the verification bar. Note across the whole batch-04 run: search results were unusually degraded (Brave consistently 429-blocked, Bing/DDG often returning off-topic or wrong-country/wrong-city content for hyperlocal queries) -- likely heavy concurrent load from the many parallel discover-fill agents sharing the same search engines right now. This looks like a tooling/contention issue rather than genuine absence of businesses in these suburbs; a re-run under lighter load may do better.

The Willows: 0 of 17 combos reached 3. All 62 crawler candidates (accountants, attorneys, beauty, books, building, clinics, fashion, financial services, general retail, hardware, hotels, logistics, marketing, nurseries, printing, solar, supermarkets) were national chains/online retailers, dictionary/definition pages or entirely unrelated results (Stack Overflow, GitHub, a Chinese-language forum) with zero Willows- or even Pretoria-specific matches; none cleared the 2-source+phone+address bar.

De Wilgers: 0 of 17 combos reached 3. All 60 crawler candidates (books, car dealerships, clinics, computer/IT, doctors, electronics, estate agents, general retail, insurance, pest control, printing, restaurants, schools, security, solar, spas) were national/online retailers or unrelated content; the only phones parsed belonged to a Johannesburg attorney (011) and a Cape Town doctor practice (021), neither a De Wilgers branch. None cleared the verification bar.

Wolmer: 0 of 14 combos reached 3. All 50 crawler candidates (business consulting, butcheries, computer/IT, general retail, hardware, industrial suppliers, liquor, logistics, marketing, motor spares, nurseries, printing, security, software) were national chains/online results with no Wolmer-specific match; none cleared the verification bar.

Irene: 0 of 13 combos reached 3. All 45 crawler candidates (accountants, books, butcheries, car dealerships, commercial property, computer/IT, engineering, events venues, financial services, furniture, logistics, restaurants, security) were national/online results or wrong-location Facebook posts (an Emfuleni municipality page, unrelated to Irene/Centurion); none cleared the verification bar.

Andeon: 0 of 10 combos reached 3. All 38 crawler candidates (business consulting, commercial property, engineering, financial services, furniture, general retail, hardware, printing, security, software) were national/online results with no Andeon-specific match; none cleared the verification bar.

Klerksoord: 0 of 7 combos reached 3. All 26 crawler candidates (automotive repairs, commercial property, furniture, general retail, marketing, motor spares, solar) were national/online results with no Klerksoord-specific match; none cleared the verification bar.

Onderstepoort: 0 of 5 combos reached 3. All 17 crawler candidates (cleaning, industrial suppliers, schools, solar, vets) were national/online results with no Onderstepoort-specific match. Batch-06 totals: 0 of 83 combos reached 3, 0 businesses published, all 298 crawler candidates discarded as unverifiable. Strong, directly-confirmed contention signal (not suburb scarcity): a manual Brave Search request made mid-run returned HTTP 429 (blocked by anti-bot protection); a manual Bing test then showed the SAME top 3 results regardless of query -- a plain query, a quoted "The Willows" phrase, and a site:facebook.com filter all returned identical generic/global results, meaning Bing itself was serving degraded, query-independent output during this run. Under lighter search-engine load this suburb set likely has real, findable businesses; a re-run is recommended once contention eases.

Wierdapark: closed fashion-clothing (added Fashion Capsule and Ifateleng). 26 of 27 combos in this suburb stayed short -- crawler candidates were almost all national chains, dictionary/definition pages or unrelated content with no Wierdapark-specific presence; one candidate (Classique Outffiters) was discarded despite matching directory listings because its own Facebook page gave a different phone number than the directories.

Erasmuskloof: added PEAK Centre (sport medicine/dietetics/psychology/biokinetics practice, categorised Clinics & Healthcare rather than the Fitness & Gyms combo it was found under, since it is professional-led rehab/wellness, not a gym floor) and Trainingwithstef Pty Ltd t/a SteFIT (HYROX training club/personal trainer, Fitness & Gyms) -- both verified via own website + an independent SA directory, with phone and street address pinned to the exact address. First-pass generic category+suburb search returned almost entirely irrelevant results (dictionary definitions, national chains, forums) for Erasmuskloof's other ~18 combos; a second, directory-biased query pass is in progress to re-check those before giving up on them.

Doornpoort: closed estate-agents (Delcor Real Estates) and marketing-advertising (INTL Studios); partially filled electronics-appliances (Nano Creations, still 1 short), insurance (BlueCare Insurance Brokers, still 1 short) and logistics-courier-transport (PostNet Doornpoort, still 1 short). 12 of 17 combos stayed at 0 -- raw crawler candidates were almost all irrelevant junk (ChatGPT/OpenAI pages, credit-report sites, dictionaries, piracy forums); most follow-up leads were discarded for wrong suburb (several businesses that directories placed in Doornpoort were actually in Pretoria North, Montana, Wonderboom or Derdepoort), missing/conflicting address or phone, single-source only, or being the same underlying business as an existing listing or another verified business this run (e.g. Bluecare Financial Services shares BlueCare Insurance Brokers' phone, so was not double-counted).

Lukasrand: 0 of 4 combos reached 3. Raw crawler candidates were national OTA/chain homepages and generic directories, all irrelevant. Follow-up leads were discarded because they turned out to be in a neighbouring suburb (guesthouses actually in Nieuw Muckleneuk/Sunnyside), were the same business as an existing listing under its full registered or junior-campus name (Rise Above Weakness Pty Ltd = existing RAW Gym; Crawford Preparatory Pretoria = same address as existing Crawford International Pretoria), or (one attorneys firm, Rudman Attorneys) had address+phone confirmed but no source describing what it actually practices, so a genuine non-padded description could not be written.

Equestria: added 7 new businesses (Travel Clinic Equestria, LTT Computer Solutions, Clicks Equestria, Al Madina Supermarket, Union Caterers, CIT Moto, Mzansi Afrika Consulting Services), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address. Discarded CJVH Estate Agent (no real address, templated suburb page), AD Care Group (phone fetch blocked, facility location ambiguous) and Absolute Pets Equestria (could not pin a phone to this branch specifically vs. its Grove Mall branch). A promising Pick n Pay Equestria candidate turned out to already be published under suburb the-willows (same phone) -- not added, not counted as discarded-unverified since it is real, just a boundary-suburb duplicate. Most of Equestria's other 11 combos (beauty, hardware, industrial suppliers, logistics, marketing, mobile phones, nurseries, opticians, software development) returned no candidate that cleared the 2-source + pinned-phone + pinned-address bar and remain short. Note on tooling: the shared discover-businesses.mjs crawler's engine order (brave, then bing, then lite.duckduckgo) was producing near-zero usable candidates across this batch -- Brave was already 429-rate-limited from other concurrent batches, and Bing's scrape was returning generic/irrelevant top-ranked pages (encyclopedia entries, national e-commerce sites, even unrelated pages) for small-suburb queries instead of falling through to lite.duckduckgo, which turned out to surface real local directory listings (procompare, cybo, africabizinfo, findglocal, pretoria.co.za, etc.) far more reliably. Re-ran discovery via a local copy (discover-businesses-v2.mjs) with lite.duckduckgo prioritised first, which is what produced usable candidates for this and subsequent checkpoints.

Muckleneuk/Accommodation combo closed to 3: added Muckleneuk Guest House (228 Cilliers Street) and Waterhouse Guest Lodge (236 & 230 Bourke Street), both 4-star B&Bs verified via their own site/Facebook plus an independent accommodation directory, phone+address pinned to the exact property. Other Muckleneuk combos checked so far (accountants, beauty, building, clinics, commercial property, computer/IT) found no candidate with both a working source and an address actually inside Muckleneuk -- brabys.com and infobel.co.za block individual listing pages (Cloudflare challenge / terms wall) so most of their candidates could not be read at all; cylex.net.za category pages often blend in neighbouring suburbs. Still working through the rest of this suburb.

Willow Park Manor: added 5 new businesses on or near Havelock Road's Co Space business park (TNC Consulting Engineers, Sila Digital Printing, BusinessPrint, GLORY ROOM Boutique, Computer Guardian), each with 2 independent sources, a real phone and a street address; this closes computer-it-services and printing-services (2 added against a need of 1) to 3. Discarded Kanya Sonke Cleaning Services (one source placed it in Nellmapius, not Willow Park Manor -- conflicting location), Funken Electrical (the business's own Facebook page says Green Street, Johannesburg, contradicting a cybo.com listing's Willow Park Manor address -- trusted the primary source and discarded), Pretoria Natural Hair Salon (no phone found, and search suggested the salon may trade under a different registered name) and RAW Auto Works (only one source -- its own site -- confirms the Willow Park Manor address; a second source filed it under 'equestria_outlying' instead, so it was left out rather than risk a wrong suburb pin). A Shepherd Removals & Deliveries candidate (11 Havelock Ave, Willow Park Manor) was dropped after validate.mjs showed its phone already belongs to an existing business published under suburb midfields-estate -- a real business, just a boundary/chain duplicate, not counted as discarded-unverified. Most of the remaining 10 combos (accountants, attorneys, automotive, beauty, catering, cleaning, commercial property, electricians, insurance, spas, supermarkets) stayed short.

Irene Farm Villages/Beauty & Hair Salons: added Cinnedene Studios (Shop 179, Basement, Irene Village Mall), a makeup/aesthetics/nails practice verified via its own site plus an independent beauty directory, still 1 short of 3. Also checked Eldoraigne's Building & Construction combo: discarded DTC Construction and GRM Roofing (both real, address+phone confirmed across 2-3 sources) because every source for each gave only a one-line directory bio with no real service detail beyond the category label -- not enough to write a genuine, non-padded 100+ word description. Business Consulting, Commercial Property, Engineering, Logistics, Pet Stores and Pharmacies (Irene Farm Villages) and most of Eldoraigne's remaining combos found nothing suburb-specific; Fitness/Nurseries candidates in this suburb turned out to be the existing BODYTEC/Irene Gardener's Nursery listings, not new businesses.
